verified_by_elf_selftest: 10,000 unique desire IDs sharing one semantic goal hash dedupe to one lineage proposal.
Each semantic goal lineage is capped per cycle.
Diversity reserve allocates attention to multiple eligible desire classes.
DesireProposal has no producer-set satiation/repetition/selected-cycle fields.
Repeated semantic goals accumulate kernel-owned history.
Kernel-owned satiation remains bounded and recovers over cycles.
Any desire proposal carrying external action authority is rejected.
Goal allocations never grant external action authority.
Tie-breaking is deterministic and input-order independent.
A 10,000-ID semantic-duplicate dominant goal attack cannot starve another eligible desire class.
known_remaining_gaps: semantic_goal_hash still needs an evidence-bound semantic-goal canonicalizer so the producer cannot mint a new hash for paraphrases of the same objective.
The current diversity floor is class-based and needs calibration against starvation/flooding cases; all numeric fractions remain TEST_REQUIRED.
Opportunity-cost allocation is bounded but not yet coupled to task deadlines, safety severity or long-horizon utility in a calibrated way.
No persistent serialized ledger/rollback contract exists yet; current reference state is in-memory shadow only.
No formal B implementation or independent C verification exists.
next_recommended_rnd: Serialized GoalEcology ledger with hash-bound checkpoint/rollback
